sn30.4-6:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn30.4-6:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā jalābujānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ …pe…
sn30.4-6:1.6: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī
sn30.4-6:1.10: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā upapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn30.4-6:1.11: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā upapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn30.4-6:1.12: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā upapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
